reasons.latest: This computer meets the requirements of the newest version.
reasons.win10Before22H2: Its Windows 10 is older than version 22H2, which Office 2024 requires.
reasons.win10Early: Its Windows 10 is one of the first releases: 2021 and 2024 need a newer one.
reasons.beforeWin10: Its Windows is older than 10, so only a classic version fits.
reasons.lowMemory: With little RAM the lightest version is best; the new ones need 4 GB.

warnings.lowMemory: There is only {{ram}} of RAM. Office will work, but it will be tight with several documents open.
warnings.windows32: 32-bit Windows: 32-bit Office will be installed, which cannot use more than 2 GB per document.
warnings.lowDisk: {{drive}} has {{free}} free and at least {{minimum}} are needed.
warnings.oldGraphics: The graphics card is old or has no driver of its own. If Word or Excel flicker, turn off hardware acceleration in File > Options > Advanced.
warnings.defenderOn: Defender is on. It does not get in the way of installing, but it will flag activation tools.

unsupported: This computer runs a Windows older than 10. Office 2019, 2021 and 2024 cannot be installed here.
